ch1.title: Aït means “those of”
ch1.p1: In Tamazight, the Amazigh language, aït names the people of one land, one household. Say Aït Bouguemez or Aït Benhaddou and everyone knows where a person comes from.
ch1.p2: Put the n in front, meaning “of”, and you get N’Aït: “of those of…”. The phrase stays open. Each of us finishes it with our own people.
ch1.p3: Maison N’Ait wears the name the way you wear a perfume: to be recognised when you walk into the room.
ch2.title: Five smells Morocco knows by heart
ch2.intro: Before the bottles there were the houses, the souks and the seasons.
rose.name: Rose
rose.text: In spring the Damask rose is picked at dawn, before the heat carries its scent away. For a few weeks the whole valley smells of it.
blossom.name: Orange blossom
blossom.text: Bitter-orange flowers are distilled at home. The water is sprinkled on a guest’s hands and scents the pastries.
cedar.name: Cedar
cedar.place: Middle Atlas, between Azrou and Ifrane
cedar.text: A dry, warm, almost sweet wood. It makes carved ceilings, linen chests and the smell of old houses.
amber.name: Amber and musk
amber.place: At the attar’s stall in the medina
amber.text: Amber is sold in small waxy cubes, musk in white blocks. Slip one into the wardrobe and the linen remembers it for months.
oud.name: Oud and bkhour
oud.text: Bkhour goes on the embers. The smoke passes into the clothes, then through the whole house. It is the smell of great occasions.
ch2.outro: Our Arabisant collection carries this family on: oud, amber, musk, incense.
film.title: The film
film.sub: Twenty-six seconds. Turn the sound on.
film.c1: Aït. In Tamazight: the people of one land.
film.c2: A land where you know your own by their scent.
film.c3: Dadès rose, orange blossom, Atlas cedar.
film.c4: Amber, musk and oud: what stays when the rest has gone.
ch3.title: A perfume is read in three stages
ch3.intro: Spray, then wait. What you smell in the first second is not what will be left tonight.
top.name: Top
top.text: Bright and light. It makes you say yes or no, and it leaves first.
heart.name: Heart
heart.text: The character of the perfume. It settles in as the top fades.
base.name: Base
base.text: Woods, amber, musk, oud: what stays on skin and on cloth.
ch3.tip: Try a perfume on skin, not on paper, and give it an hour.
ch3.sizes: Three sizes depending on the product: 50, 75 and 100 ml.
ch4.title: The collections
ch4.intro: Twenty-five families and more than a hundred and sixty scents, in three collections. A fourth is being prepared.
ch4.note: Our “Style” creations are the house’s own interpretations, inspired by famous perfumes. The brand names quoted belong to their owners; Maison N’Ait is not affiliated with any of them.
desc.arabisant: Oud, amber, musk, incense: the spirit of the great Gulf houses.
desc.unisexe: The Unisex collection is being prepared. It will arrive soon.
